book: Sefer Yetzirah — The Book of Formation

1: In thirty-two wondrous paths of wisdom did Yah, the Lord of Hosts, the God of Israel, the Living God and King of the Universe, engrave His name — in three books: in Number, in Letter, and in Word.
Ten sefirot of nothingness, and twenty-two letters are the foundation: three mothers, seven doubles, and twelve simples.
Depth of Beginning, depth of End; depth of Good, depth of Evil; depth of Above, depth of Below; depth of East, depth of West — and one Master, one God, one Lord of all, above them all.

Behold the ten sefirot as they are: the soul of all that is formed and of all that shall be formed. They are as a tree, and the letters are its branches; the tree without branches is nothing, and the branches without the tree fall.
2: Twenty-two letters: Thou hast engraved them, O Lord, Thou hast carved them, Thou hast weighed them, Thou hast changed them, and with them Thou hast formed the soul of all creation and the soul of all things yet to be created.
The three mothers — Aleph, Mem, Shin — are as a balance: one in the scale of merit, one in the scale of guilt, and the tongue of the law holds the balance between them.
From the Breath of the Living God came air, and from air came water, and from water came fire; and with these He sealed the heights and the depths, the north and the south, the east and the west.
3: He made the letters a crown, and combined them, and weighed them, and sealed them — and from them were formed the heavens and the earth, and all the hosts of them.
[Yetzirah 6:4 — The end is in the beginning]

Look at all things with wonder, and know that the end is bound to the beginning, and the beginning to the end. As good proceeds from good, so evil proceeds from evil; for nothing in the balance of creation is alone.

When Abraham our father came to understand this, and to contemplate it, and to practice it, the Holy One, blessed be He, revealed Himself to him, and called him His friend, and made a covenant with him between the ten fingers of his hands.
